title: seed_schema
description: Internal one-time-per-customer canonical baseline seed. NOT registered as an agent gateway tool — invoked only by terraform's aws_lambda_invocation at provisioning. Reads each canonical registry JSON from operator's canonical S3 bucket and bulk-writes into the customer's per-customer registry DDB with origin='canonical'. Idempotent.

customer_id.description: Tenant identifier — used only for trace logging. Table name comes from SCHEMA_TABLE env var.
